اقتطفتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفَتَا (iqtaṭafatā) /iq.ta.tˤa.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفَتَا (uqtuṭifatā) /uq.tu.tˤi.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
